name: redline
description: A Claude Code plugin that writes ~/.claude/usage.json and shows usage-limit toasts in VS Code sessions, where the status line never runs.

toastSeconds.title: Toast duration (seconds)
toastSeconds.description: How long usage toasts stay on screen. Default 6.

alertToastSeconds.title: Alert toast duration (seconds)
alertToastSeconds.description: How long the highest-level and write-failure toasts stay on screen. Default 10.

levels.title: Toast levels (percent)
levels.description: Usage percentages that trigger a toast, separated by commas. Up to 5, from 1 to 100. The highest is the alert level. Default 70, 90, 95.

previewToasts.title: Preview sample toasts
previewToasts.description: On shows one sample of each toast style on the first turn after Claude Code restarts. For checking how toasts look and how long they last. Default Off.
